method: Retained native PDF character counts, including alphanumerics and clinical math/arrow symbols, compared to structured HTML before separately transcribed figure tables. Clipped, invisible imported-template text and native text occluded by genuine figures are excluded and the rendered illustration is retained instead. Whitespace, list-marker glyphs and reading order are not validated by this digest. Table grids and selected dose/column pairings are separately tested. This is conversion verification, not medical validation.
